chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Ibrahim al-Karkhi, who said:

I bought a slave girl for Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him). So when I went to pay them the dirhams, I said, 'Can I ask for a reduction?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'No. Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade reduction after the deal.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), referring to Imam al-Sadiq
key_terms.الاسْتِحْطَاط: Asking for a reduction in price after the deal is concluded
key_terms.الصَّفْقَة: The deal or concluded sale transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to ask for a discount after the sale deal is concluded?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific prohibition of 'al-istihṭāṭ' (demanding a price reduction or 'haggle-back') after a sale contract is finalized, distinguishing it from the pre-contract bargaining phase. It underscores the principle of finality and good faith in commercial transactions, rooted in the Prophet’s tradition, ensuring that the agreed price is binding once the deal is struck. This ruling prevents opportunistic renegotiation and promotes trustworthiness in market dealings within Shia jurisprudence.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibrahim Al Karkhy who said,

‘I bought a slave girl for Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>. So when I went to fetch the Dirhams, I said, ‘Can I ask for a reduction?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. Rasool-Allah<sup>ajwj</sup> forbade from the reduction after the (conclusion of) the deal’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Ibrahim al-Kharkhiy who has said the following: “I once bought a slave-girl for abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and went to get dirhams and I asked him (the Imam), ‘Can I ask to reduce the price ? 5

He (the Imam) said, ‘No, because the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, prohibited asking for reduction after the deal is finalized.’”
